key_impacts: Severe social, economic and psychological impacts
evidence_snippets: 17 January 1995… an earthquake… shook the city of Kobe and adjoining areas in Hyogo Prefecture.
Destroyed thousands of houses and left millions of people homeless.

key_impacts: High levels of building damage reported

The human toll—35 lives lost—was far less severe.
